prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Kael Vespera. Character visual motifs: weathered oath collector with paired crescent ledgers as blades, stitched gray cape and ink-red wrist seals.
TOP LEFT: Outstanding Balance. Ability concept: first melee contact with a hero issues a visible 4 s Contract: target receives a 4% damage discount from Kael, but each shield granted during the Contract accumulates *Debt* (capped at 160). Only Kael may collect; no denial of healing.
TOP RIGHT: Collection Line. Ability concept: short sweeping arc which draws a red boundary on the ground for 2 s. Contracted targets crossing it pay a fraction of Debt as magic damage; staying put avoids payment.
BOTTOM LEFT: Witness Required. Ability concept: Kael braces for 0.8 s. If the contracted enemy or a defender hits her during the brace, she gains a dashless counter slash and a 1 s damage reduction; otherwise she is vulnerable after bracing.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Terms of Mercy. Ability concept: challenges a contracted target for 4 s. Their team can clear the Contract by landing two attacks on Kael, or ignore it and let Kael cash out accrued Debt as a single capped hit. Does not suppress, force 1v1, or execute automatically.
